rapidapi_analysis.viability: Yes, viable distribution channel for DeepSeek-powered APIs. Low barrier to entry (no upfront cost), 5M+ developer base, 20% rev share. Estimated monthly revenue per API: $500–$5,000 with proper marketing and freemium tier. Implementation complexity: low (wrap DeepSeek API with FastAPI/Flask). Capital required: $0–$100 for hosting (e.g., Railway, Fly.io).
